scale_cues: White square dinner plate assumed about 26-27 cm across, filling most of the frame; cherry tomatoes (about 2.5-3 cm each, roughly 10-12 g each) used as an internal size reference for the chicken cubes, which lie mostly in a single layer with some overlap.
assumptions: Plate is a standard ~26-27 cm square dinner plate; no cutlery or hand in frame to confirm scale.
Chicken is skinless breast meat, grilled or roasted, with no visible sauce; no visible oil pooling, so any cooking oil is not listed separately.
About 55-65 chicken pieces at roughly 2 g each, mostly single layer.
Six cherry/grape tomatoes at about 10-12 g each.
Small crumbs on the plate are chicken fragments and are included in the chicken estimate.
The partial second plate at the left edge is empty and not part of the meal.
